heat_calculation_page.hero_title: Calculation of Heat and Fuel Requirements
heat_calculation_page.hero_sub2: For obtaining technical conditions from PJSC Gazprom, JSC Mosgaz, JSC Mosoblgaz
heat_calculation_page.purpose_desc1: Calculation of heat and fuel requirements (TTR) is required for facilities where natural gas is planned to be used as fuel and/or for process needs, as well as in cases of reconstruction or technical retrofitting of existing facilities where gas-consuming equipment is being replaced.
heat_calculation_page.purpose_card1: Determination of facility thermal energy demand (Gcal) for heating, ventilation, domestic hot water, and process needs (maximum hourly and annual loads)
heat_calculation_page.purpose_card2: Determination of natural gas volume (m3) required to generate thermal energy and process needs (maximum hourly and annual gas consumption)
heat_calculation_page.purpose_card3: Selection of gas-using equipment for thermal energy generation
heat_calculation_page.purpose_desc2: TTR serves as the official basis for applying to gas supply organizations (JSC Mosgaz, JSC Mosoblgaz, PJSC Gazprom) for grid connection or reconstruction of existing gas consumption networks.
heat_calculation_page.step1: Submit an inquiry on the website or by phone
heat_calculation_page.step2: We send a questionnaire depending on the building type
heat_calculation_page.step3: We prepare and issue a standard contract
heat_calculation_page.step4: We execute the thermal engineering calculations
heat_calculation_page.step5: We dispatch 2 copies of the report along with acceptance certificates and invoice
heat_calculation_page.norm_docs_desc: The calculation of heat and fuel requirements is carried out in strict accordance with approved methodologies and regulatory standards:
heat_calculation_page.doc1_info: "Methodology for determining fuel, electric energy, and water requirements in the generation and transmission of heat energy and coolants in municipal heating systems" (Gosstroy RF 2004)
heat_calculation_page.doc3_info: "Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning" (Updated version of SNiP 41-01-2003)
heat_calculation_page.doc4_info: "Internal Water Supply and Sewerage of Buildings" (Updated version of SNiP 2.04.01-85*).
heat_calculation_page.order_caption: Submit an application for thermal calculation before the end of the week and receive a 30% discount
heat_calculation_page.order_desc: Leave a request and we will contact you to clarify details, send a questionnaire, and perform calculations. Payment is made after receiving the calculation results.
